# uptimekuma_notification_signalgrid (Resource)

Signalgrid notification resource. Signalgrid is a push notification service. Requires Uptime Kuma 2.5.4 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_signalgrid" "example" {
  name       = "Signalgrid Notifications"
  client_key = "your-signalgrid-client-key"
  channel    = "alerts"
  is_default = false
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: client_key_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change client_key_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_signalgrid" "write_only" {
  name    = "Signalgrid with a write-only secret"
  channel = "alerts"

  client_key_wo         = "your-signalgrid-client-key"
  client_key_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel` (String) The Signalgrid channel the push is sent to.
- `name` (String) Notification name

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `client_key` (String, Sensitive) The Signalgrid client key. Stored in state; use `client_key_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `client_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Signalgrid client key, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `client_key`; requires `client_key_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `client_key_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `client_key` until the next apply with `client_key_wo` set removes it from state.
- `client_key_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `client_key_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `client_key_wo`.
- `is_default` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
